title: Presentations
summary: PowerPoint is a slide show program used for training, education and business presentations; it enhances presentations with pictures, sound effects, tables and charts. Start: Start, All Programs, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Office PowerPoint 2013. The start screen offers installed templates or a Blank presentation. Installed templates and installed themes give ready backgrounds and text formatting; a blank presentation is used to start from scratch.

Slide layouts: nine layouts – Title Slide, Title and Content, Section Header, Two Content, Comparison, Title Only, Blank, Content with Caption, Picture with Caption. Content elements: Table, Chart, SmartArt Graphic, Picture from file, Clip Art and Media Clip. To open an existing presentation use File, Open, select the folder and file and click Open.

Normal view (main window with the current slide, outline pane on the left, notes pane at the bottom), Slide Sorter view (small image of each slide; order and sort slides, add transitions) and Slide Show view (preview and deliver the presentation with sounds, animations, hyperlinks and actions working). Normal and Slide Sorter are for creating; Slide Show is for presenting. Choose them from the view buttons at the bottom right or the View tab.
Use contrasting colours for text and background; font size of 24 points or larger; short phrases; simple transitions; avoid clutter; do not mix many text effects; keep the text crisp and short.

Changing the design template: Design tab, click a template. Changing the layout: Home, Layout, click a layout thumbnail. New Slide offers Duplicate Selected Slides, Slides from Outline and Reuse Slides. Duplicating a slide makes a copy after the current slide when similar slides are needed: right-click the slide and choose Duplicate Slide or press Ctrl+Shift+D. Reorder slides by dragging in Slide Sorter or the slide pane. Hide a slide that should not appear in the show but should not be deleted: right-click the slide in the slide pane and choose Hide (unhide the same way). Moving between slides: scroll bars, Next Slide/Previous Slide buttons or the outline pane.

The Format tab appears when an object is selected. For text: Insert Shapes, Shape Styles (outline, fill, shadow, glow, bevel), WordArt Styles, Arrange and Size. For an image: Adjust (colour, contrast, brightness, compress, artistic effects) and Picture Styles (border styles, border colour and thickness, shadow, 3D rotation) in addition to Arrange and Size.

Commands are on the Review tab in four sections: Proofing (Spelling, Research, Thesaurus for synonyms and antonyms), Language, Compare (compare and combine another presentation) and Comments (New Comment, Delete, Previous, Next, Show Comments). To add a comment: select the object, click Review tab, click New Comment, type the suggestion in the Comments pane; the reviewer's name appears in the box.

Save the file, click File tab, Info, Protect Presentation, Encrypt with Password, enter the password in the Encrypt Document dialog box and click OK, re-enter it in Confirm Password and click OK. To remove, repeat the steps and delete the password.

Insert audio: Insert tab, Media section, arrow below Audio, choose Audio on My PC (or Record Audio), browse, select the file and click Insert; a sound icon with controls appears and can be dragged out of view. Insert video: Insert tab, arrow below Video, choose Online Videos or Video on My PC, browse, select and click Insert; resize with handles; it plays when you click it in the show. Themes are inbuilt coloured layouts with matching background, fonts and effects: Design tab, Themes section, choose a theme (applied to the whole presentation); modify with the Variants section: Colors, Fonts, Effects and Background Styles. Hyperlink: a text or image that opens another file, web page, image or mail address: select the object, Insert tab, Links section, Hyperlink, choose Existing File or Web Page (Current Folder, Browsed Pages, Recent Files or type the address) and click OK; to remove it right-click and choose Remove Hyperlink. Charts: Insert tab, Chart; change type with Change Chart Type on the Design tab.

Google Slides: open Google's home page, click the grid, click Drive, log in with Gmail, click New, choose Google Slides, a blank presentation appears; add and format text, images and videos, save and share. It needs internet connectivity but is easy to share.
q1: How many slide layouts are available in the New Slide dialog box?
Nine.
Which view is used to show the presentation in a conference?
Slide Show view.
Which tab contains the Thesaurus option?
The Review tab (Proofing section).
On which tab is the Hyperlink command found?
The Insert tab (Links section).
What is the shortcut key to duplicate a slide?
Ctrl + Shift + D.
Which tab is used to apply a theme?
The Design tab.
Name the three options in the Proofing section of the Review tab.
Spelling, Research and Thesaurus.
How do you remove a hyperlink from a presentation?
Right-click the hyperlink and click Remove Hyperlink.
Which button changes the type of a chart on a slide?
Change Chart Type on the Design tab.
What is the recommended minimum font size for slides?
24 points or larger.
Which option protects a PowerPoint presentation with a password?
File, Info, Protect Presentation, Encrypt with Password.
Which tab appears only when an object on the slide is selected?
The Format tab.
q2: Define the following: (a) Slide Sorter view (b) Themes.

(a) Slide Sorter view shows a small image of each slide so slides can be ordered and sorted and transitions added. (b) Themes are inbuilt coloured layouts with matching background, fonts and effects applied to the whole presentation.

(a) What is the purpose of hiding slides? How can a slide be hidden? (b) What is meant by duplicating slides? How is it done?

(a) A hidden slide is not shown in the slide show but is not deleted; right-click the slide in the slide pane and choose Hide. (b) Duplicating makes a copy of a slide after the current one; right-click and choose Duplicate Slide or press Ctrl+Shift+D.
April 2026
Write the steps to insert a saved audio on your presentation.
Click the Insert tab; in the Media section click the arrow below Audio; choose Audio on My PC; browse and select the audio file; click Insert.

Proofing (spelling, research, thesaurus), Language (choose the language), Compare (compare and combine presentations) and Comments (add, delete, view comments).
October 2025
Explain the options found under the Review tab which help the reviewer to review a presentation.
Proofing checks spelling and finds synonyms; Language sets the language; Compare combines versions; Comments lets the reviewer add, delete and navigate comments.
April 2025
Write the steps to insert a hyperlink in your presentation.
Select the text or image; click the Insert tab and Hyperlink in the Links section; choose the file or web page (or type the address); click OK.
April 2025
Write the steps to protect a PowerPoint presentation.
Save the file; File tab, Info, Protect Presentation, Encrypt with Password; enter the password and click OK; re-enter it to confirm and click OK.
April 2024
What are themes in a presentation and how can they be applied?
Themes are inbuilt colour layouts with background, fonts and effects; click the Design tab and select a theme in the Themes section.
April 2024
Write the steps to insert audio and video in your presentation.
Audio: Insert tab, Audio, Audio on My PC, select file, Insert. Video: Insert tab, Video, Video on My PC, select file, Insert.
October 2024
How can you add comments in the presentation while reviewing it? Write the steps.
Select the object; click the Review tab; click New Comment; type the suggestion in the Comments pane.
October 2024
Write the steps to change the layout of a slide.
Click the Home tab, click Layout, and click one of the nine layouts.
Write the steps to change the colour of an applied theme.
Click the Design tab; in the Variants section click the down arrow; choose Colors and select a colour theme.
Differentiate between Normal view and Slide Show view.
Normal view is for creating and editing a slide with outline and notes panes; Slide Show view displays slides full screen with sound, animations and hyperlinks working.
q3: Explain the three views of PowerPoint.
Normal view has the slide, outline pane and notes pane; Slide Sorter view shows thumbnails to order slides and add transitions; Slide Show view runs the presentation for the audience.
List the slide layouts available in PowerPoint (any six) and the use of any two.

Title Slide, Title and Content, Section Header, Two Content, Comparison, Title Only, Blank, Content with Caption, Picture with Caption. Title Slide starts a presentation; Comparison is for pro and con lists.
Write the design tips for making good slides.
Use contrasting colours, font size 24 or more, short phrases, simple transitions, avoid clutter and avoid mixing many text effects.
Explain how to format an image inserted in a slide.

Select the image; click the Format tab; use Adjust to change colour, contrast and brightness; use Picture Styles to apply borders and effects such as shadow and 3D rotation; use Size and Arrange to resize and align.
Explain how to modify the applied theme.

Click the Design tab; in the Variants section use Colors to change colours, Fonts to change fonts, Effects to change effects and Background Styles to choose a background; the whole presentation changes.
Write the steps to create an online presentation in Google Slides.
Open Google's home page, click the grid and Drive, log in with Gmail, click New, choose Google Slides; add text, images and videos; save and share the presentation.
Write the steps to protect a presentation with a password and remove it.
File, Info, Protect Presentation, Encrypt with Password, type the password, OK, confirm it, OK. To remove it repeat the steps, delete the password and click OK.
